description: This file is an implementation of the ContentService interface for managing content entities in a sales manager application. It provides methods for CRUD operations, managing content files such as images and static files, and retrieving content by various criteria. The class integrates with content DAOs and file management modules and is annotated as a Spring service.

classes.name: ContentServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ContentService interface, providing content management and file handling functionalities.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content entities filtered by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Content entity by its instance.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by ID and language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches Content by its code and store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves Content entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing Content entity.

methods.name: addContentFile
